prompt: Square detailed painterly naturalistic encyclopedia illustration of Pakhangba, primordial serpent deity of Manipur. ONE limbless smooth-scaled natural SNAKE with two branched SANGAI DEER BROW ANTLERS atop its otherwise ordinary reptile head. Snake's face must have smooth compact cheek scales, ordinary closed snake mouth and round reptile eyes. No mane, no whiskers, no beard, no hair, no frills, no spikes, no dragon decorations: pure serpent anatomy with only documented deer antlers. One continuous long coiled body with tapering natural snake tail on moonlit Manipur forest clearing beside small quiet shrine. Antlers angle gracefully outward, broad brow tines like sangai deer. Whole antlered head and coils comfortably framed. Aura calm majestic divine sovereignty and sacred primordial nocturnal presence, silver moonlight and subdued golden temple lamps. Natural scales, painterly mist. No wings, limbs, crowns, weapons, flames, victims, text or watermark.
visual_requirements: Sangai deer brow antlers on snake head

visual_review.notes: One natural smooth-faced limbless scaled serpent with paired branched brow antlers, continuous coiled body and natural tapering tail. No whiskers, mane, spines, limbs or wings. Upright calm gaze, silver moon and quiet shrine lamps convey primordial sacred divine sovereignty.
